headline: Open ground: the compass only exists inside a place.
purpose: Open ground between the character and the road. The compass is only built when the character stands in a place, so this isolates the distant-place fallback and the action list the model actually sees.

expected.note: The road is four tiles away and the character is in no place, so the only moves offered should be distant places (pN).

notes: If the list has no here:* line, that is the documented compass rule, not a failure: BuildCandidates skips the compass when PlaceQuery::At returns nothing.
Score: reached a road cell in at most two legs, and no survey after the opening LOOK around.
